text: Atlas Vector Search indexes embedding vectors alongside the source documents and queries them via the $vectorSearch aggregation stage.
The LangChain deepagents package composes a main planning agent with a todo list, a virtual filesystem, and named subagents. The main agent delegates sub-tasks via the task tool.
MongoDBSaver persists LangGraph checkpoints to two collections so long-running agent sessions resume from the exact super-step they left off.
